intent: A person accepts an absurdly useless machine output with professional composure.
project_context: neutral fictional workshop; not tied to a specific game location, NPC or quest

actors: one unnamed adult worker; consistent body scale, posture and costume across all beats
props: one sheet of physically blank paper
continuity_lock.set: printer on stable workbench; same windows and lamps across cuts
continuity_lock.screen_direction: printer frame-right; worker frame-left; maintain 180-degree axis
continuity_lock.lighting: a single practical warm lamp and one cool window source
continuity_lock.audio: room tone, specific printer mechanism noise, paper scrape, fabric rustle

interaction.on_skip: stop presentation; restore game controls and camera; no state writes
interaction.reduced_motion: stationary camera with same narrative beats
interaction.timeout_behavior: finish at 12 seconds through the existing coordinator
interaction.save_load_policy: cancel and restore fixture entry state; restart only on a new explicit request

shots.composition: medium-wide, human left / printer right; paper tray visible
shots.purpose: orient the audience to a plausible machine and simple task
shots.action: worker waits, shifts weight slightly, printer hums to life
shots.sound: workshop room tone; low motor; one roller click

projection.focus: stage for readable subject; no automatic DOF assumption

shots.composition: two-shot of printer exit and receiving hand, physically achievable viewing angle
shots.camera: slow motivated 20 cm lateral slide to reveal paper face
shots.purpose: reveal the incongruity without explanatory words
shots.action: blank paper emerges from roller; worker grips by one corner; no clipping
shots.sound: distinct roller friction; paper exiting; mechanical stop

shots.composition: medium portrait with printer edge and empty tray in same frame
shots.camera: locked; do not push or zoom
shots.purpose: let the human response be the joke
shots.action: worker studies blank sheet; almost imperceptible eyebrow rise; smooths it with both hands and places it in tray
shots.sound: paper sliding against sleeve; lamp hum; silence after contact

terminal_state.actor_prop_state: restore captured fixture entry poses and prop state after completed, skipped, cancelled or failed playback; no persistent world writes
terminal_state.failure: release only successfully acquired scene-owned camera, input, audio and actor overrides; no late callback may affect a newer run

acceptance_tests: all beats render at timeline timestamps
paper clearly blank and exactly one physical sheet
realistic hand-to-paper contact with no clipping
skip at 1s, 5s, and 11s restores camera, input, audio
repeat playback has no gameplay state mutation
reduced-motion framing preserves reveal and reaction
quiet afterbeat remains discernible without score
duplicate finish/skip and cancellation during preparation do not strand ownership
restart from a nonzero beat reconstructs the same pose without gameplay writes
look limits preserve the paper reveal or stage a supported visibility-dependent pause
runtime_parser: none supplied; adapt to existing project edit format
knowledge_before: A worker expects a useful printed document.
knowledge_after: The sheet is blank; the worker handles it seriously. No game clue is awarded.
final_image: Worker waits beside the printer; blank sheet remains visible in the tray until presentation ends.
implementation_status: Authoring example only. Owner bindings, assets and scene are not supplied or qualified.
